title: A Oath for the Garden
author: J. M. Eastwick
blurb: Jonah Zhou, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
